pricing.lead: Cost comparison: original price → converted equivalent → annual cost → effective token cost.
pricing.rateNote: Conversion rule: CNY = USD × {rate}, with the factor from config/exchange_rate.yaml (daily D-7 ~ D-1 seven-day average, never hardcoded). It is an approximation for cross-plan comparison, not a live payment / settlement rate.
pricing.seatCalc.note: seat is a pricing quantity, not a plan tier — no separate plan files are created for 2 / 5 / 20 seats. Every team cost is derived in the presentation layer via annual_cost = annual price per seat × seat_count. Also note: billed yearly ≠ quota issued yearly — enterprise seat members' quota refreshes monthly (see the quota column on the Plans page).
pricing.seatCalc.noDiscount: discount: no public discount from the vendor
pricing.seatCalc.prorate: added seats are prorated for the remaining days and expire with the original subscription
pricing.seatCalc.output: Annual cost {annual} · avg monthly team cost {monthly}
